Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. In that case, you add as many as possible to the hand.
Card Q&A.q: Can I still add to the hand with this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect if I only reveal 1 green Digimon card among the top 5 cards of my deck?

Effect: [End of Opponent's Turn][Once Per Turn] By suspending 1 of your Digimon, reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Add 2 green Digimon cards among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of deck.
